name: Vulcan Tools
description: Proxies Vulcan LuaSkills tools into OpenClaw through vulcan-host.

protoPath.description: Path to vulcan-mcp-client/proto/v1/mcp_service.proto for dynamic gRPC loading.

enabled.description: Whether this plugin should expose Vulcan tools.

host.description: Optional local vulcan-host autostart policy used by no-TUI OpenClaw installs.

autoStart.description: Whether vulcan-tools should auto-start one local vulcan-host background process when the configured endpoint is unreachable.

command.description: Optional explicit vulcan-mcp executable path or PATH command used by runtime autostart.

args.description: Optional extra command-line arguments passed to the auto-started vulcan-host process.

cwd.description: Optional working directory used when the runtime auto-starts vulcan-host.

readyTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for vulcan-host readiness after runtime autostart.

env.description: Optional extra environment variables injected into the auto-started vulcan-host process.
